name: Kuruwa Kamusabi Episode:01 - Kongou Fukan
original_name: クルワカムサビ EPISODE：01 コンゴウフカン
source:
The red-lights district in which God and an evil spirit are present
***
A strange part of the city.
A place heretofore unseen, beckoning one to enter.
They say that in the back alleys of Kamusabi, a man's dreams and fantasies come true.
Every woman who holds quarters here holds them for play.
A man with enough money could buy anything.
He was such a man. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134963.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
上帝与邪灵同时存在的红灯区
***
这座城市的一个奇怪的地方。
一个迄今为止从未见过的地方，召唤着人们进入。
人们说，在卡穆萨比的后巷里，男人的梦想和幻想得以实现。
每个在这里住的女人都是为了玩耍而住的。
一个人有足够的钱可以买任何东西。
他就是这样一个人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134963.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
